excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Heat stroke
excerpts.text: Consider symptoms of heat stroke with high ambient temperature, like elevated core body temperature, confusion, agitation, disorientation, seizures or unresponsiveness.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Heat stroke, passive cooling
excerpts.text: With suspected heat stroke remove the person from the heat source and commence passive cooling by removing excess clothing and placing the person in a cooler/shaded location

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Heat stroke, active cooling
excerpts.text: Use any technique immediately available to provide active cooling, if core temperature >40°C.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Heat stroke, duration
excerpts.text: If a core temperature cannot be obtained, continue cooling for 15 min or until neurological symptoms resolve, whichever is first.
